findings.rationale: The block scanner searches for recognized headers and counts braces without tracking comments, while top_lines counts braces without respecting quoted strings. Valid comments containing block-like text can create spurious or unterminated declarations, and braces inside string values can suppress subsequent clauses.

Projects support multiple ai_component declarations, but replay reduces them to one mutable summary. Each new component replaces only the name and retains omitted fields from the previous component; selection therefore rejects every component except the last and may validate the last component against inherited contract values.

Markdown materialization uses only the source stem and process ID for a predictable temporary pathname, then std::fs::write follows or truncates any existing entry. Re-entry for the same path aliases the same file, and a pre-existing symlink can redirect the write; creation should use a unique, exclusively created file.
